links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and agreement of ChatGPT versus epileptologists and neurologists on same vignettes
links.effect: Human experts consistently outperformed ChatGPT with near-perfect accuracy and higher kappa; ChatGPT specificity was low (26.7% for epilepsy diagnosis, 33.3% for acute symptomatic vs unprovoked seizures).
links.quote: Human experts consistently outperformed ChatGPT with near-perfect accuracy and higher κ values.

unlisted_practices: Customizing ChatGPT with official ILAE epilepsy diagnosis and classification documents ('training') before diagnostic use

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4 diagnostic accuracy on clinical vignettes compared to expert clinicians without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
